neighbours.label: a reactive salt-forming metal (alkali or alkaline earth: sodium, lithium, calcium, magnesium, barium), as against other elements such as copper, silver or nitrogen
fire: The flame turned crimson when strontium salts were added.
The lab cooled rubidium atoms with lasers in the chamber.
Milk is a rich source of calcium for growing bones.
The battery uses a lithium anode and a thin separator.
Doctors measured the sodium level in the patient's blood.
Engineers added beryllium to harden the alloy for aircraft.
The tablet contains magnesium hydroxide and a flavoring.
The technician mixed barium sulfate into the contrast fluid.
quiet: The flame turned blue when copper salts were added.
The lab cooled helium atoms with lasers in the chamber.
Milk is a rich source of protein for growing bones.
The battery uses a graphite anode and a thin separator.
Doctors measured the glucose level in the patient's blood.
Engineers added nickel to harden the alloy for aircraft.
The tablet contains iron and a sweet flavoring.
The technician mixed silver flakes into the contrast fluid.

notes: Probes: lithium, sodium, potassium, magnesium, barium and cesium 0.23-0.50; gold, silver, copper, oxygen, nitrogen and iron under 0.06; zinc 0.15. Card top peaks also include Pb and hydrogen, which do not fit the distinction.
